html:
Slides from a talk by Cheol-Ho Jeong, professor at the Technical University of Denmark (DTU), at the 24th International Congress on Acoustics (ICA 2022), shared on Ziyu Acoustics. They put two questions to anyone who runs acoustic simulations: how confident are you in your results, and what are the main reasons they turn out inaccurate?

The slides themselves are in the original WeChat post.

Source: Cheol-Ho Jeong, ICA 2022; shared by Fanyu Meng on Ziyu Acoustics.
